description: This Java source file defines the EnterpriseApplication class, which sets up and runs an embedded Jetty server to serve a web application packaged inside a shaded JAR. It includes main method logic for initializing the server, configuring web context resources from the classpath, handling system properties for port configuration, and managing graceful shutdown.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class that boots an embedded Jetty server and serves web application packaged inside the shaded JAR.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes and starts the Jetty server with configured web application context.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves network port for Jetty server based on system properties, defaulting to 8090.
